notices.title: The next update is close
notices.body:
1.8.5 turned into a much bigger update than I planned, mostly because of what people emailed in. Thank you to everyone who wrote. Most of this update is made of your messages. Here is what is in it.

WHAT IS COMING
• Seven themes. Colours, bar shape, background and typeface in one tap, and they reach the Lock Screen, the Dynamic Island, the widgets and the watch.
• An Apple Watch page on your phone, with a live preview of your wrist.
• Both Dynamic Island numbers are yours to choose. Hold the Island for as many as six meters.
• The Lock Screen card is yours to arrange: how many meters, a bar on each or none, where the refresh button sits, and what sits on the bottom line.
• A Privacy page listing every address the app contacts, and why.

WHAT IS FIXED
• Codex sign-in. An invisible extra line in a pasted token stopped it being sent at all, and then the app told you the token was rejected.
• The refresh button could come back with nothing and leave the card looking unchanged, so you could not tell. It says so now.
• Disconnect clears your credentials on your other devices too. It warns you first now.
• Widgets ignored a switch between light and dark.

ON iOS 27
The extra room in iOS 27 turns out to be a bigger widget size rather than a bigger Lock Screen card, so that is where it is going, and it is the next thing I am building. The card gained room anyway, from a different direction: hold the Dynamic Island and it now shows as many as six meters instead of three.

Keep them coming. If you are about to report something, it is worth updating first.

notices.title: More from OpenRouter in the next update
notices.body: OpenRouter is about to get proper meters: spend today, this week and this month, your key's own total, and a heads-up before a key expires — not just a credit balance. Claude credits get a fix as well, so a spend limit you haven't set no longer shows as a permanent 0%. Coming shortly.

notices.title: Some meters missing from the Main focus list
notices.body: The update just released introduced a bug but is being fixed right now: switching a meter off under Focus > Also show on Lock Screen also removes it from the Main focus list, so choices like Session (5 hr) can go missing. Sorry to anyone this caught out. Until the fix arrives you can still change your focus in Settings > Live Activity > Focus meter, which always lists every meter.

notices.title: A new unnamed meter may appear for Claude accounts
notices.body: Anthropic has switched on a hidden usage bucket that some Claude accounts now report, so an unfamiliar meter at 0% may have appeared on your dashboard. It is not a bug, and your real meters are unaffected. We do not yet know what it is. A fix has already been submitted to Apple and is awaiting review, which can take some time. It hides unannounced meters until they show real usage, and adds a setting to reveal them early, so brand new models still appear between app updates.
